metadata.notes: Chapter spans multiple scenes over several weeks within the Alpha Centauri system, including both Alpha Centauri B reconnaissance and Alpha Centauri A combat.

believes: The wreckage in Alpha Centauri B is from the missing USE probe being attacked by the Brazilian Empire.
The Brazilian probe that established the Alpha Centauri construction yard has already departed the system.
The escaping Brazilian vessel may be incomplete and poorly armed.
learns: Alpha Centauri B is not a viable human colony candidate and contains only sparse planetary formation.
The missing USE probe reached Alpha Centauri B, built autofactory equipment and additional vessels, and was destroyed there.
Goku found an active Brazilian autofactory in Alpha Centauri A building four probes.
One Brazilian vessel escaped the attack on the Brazilian construction yard.

Calvin and Goku decide to report the Brazilian construction yard battle and their recommendation for combat-class expansion in Alpha Centauri.
communications.notes: The chapter states they plan to send this back to Bill; transmission itself is implied at scene end.

combat.notes: Calvin and Goku execute a high-speed surprise attack on the Brazilian construction yard in Alpha Centauri A; one Brazilian vessel escapes.

infrastructure.notes: Calvin concludes Alpha Centauri B has sufficient resources and plans to set up an autofactory there if time permits.
The Brazilian construction yard in Alpha Centauri A is largely destroyed in Calvin and Goku's attack.

relationships.text: Calvin and Goku coordinate effectively in reconnaissance and combat, reinforcing their operational partnership despite their teasing friction.

scenes.summary: Calvin silently reconnoiters Alpha Centauri B, launches scouts, and surveys the sparse system.
Calvin's scouts find wreckage in the Alpha Centauri B asteroid belt that he identifies as the missing USE expedition.
Calvin rendezvous with Goku, learns of an active Brazilian autofactory in Alpha Centauri A, and agrees to attack it.
Calvin and Goku execute a surprise high-speed strike that destroys most of the Brazilian construction yard and all four incoming missiles, but one Brazilian vessel escapes.
After inspecting the wreckage, Calvin and Goku conclude Alpha Centauri needs combat-class Bob expansion and further survey of Alpha Centauri A's comfort-zone planet.

events.text: Calvin discovers the missing USE probe's wreckage in Alpha Centauri B, confirming it reached the system and was destroyed after beginning replication.
Calvin and Goku destroy the Brazilian construction yard in Alpha Centauri A, wiping out the autofactory, three nearly completed probes, and four missiles while one Brazilian vessel escapes.

summary.one_line: Calvin finds the lost USE probe's wreckage in Alpha Centauri B, then joins Goku in destroying a Brazilian construction yard in Alpha Centauri A.
summary.paragraph: Calvin's stealth reconnaissance of Alpha Centauri B shows it is a poor colony candidate, but it does uncover the remains of the missing USE expedition in the asteroid belt. At a rendezvous between the two stars, Goku reports an active Brazilian autofactory in Alpha Centauri A building new probes, and the two Bobs decide to attack under the standing consensus that Medeiros has already made peace impossible. Their high-speed surprise strike devastates the yard, destroys most of the Brazilian assets, and eliminates four incoming missiles, though one Brazilian vessel escapes. Afterward, Calvin and Goku conclude that Alpha Centauri now needs combat-class Bob reinforcements and further survey of the potentially habitable planet around Alpha Centauri A.
events: Calvin silently surveys Alpha Centauri B and finds it sparse, with no promising habitable world for humanity.
His scouts discover wreckage in the asteroid belt that he identifies as the missing USE probe and its destroyed replication effort.
Calvin rendezvous with Goku between Alpha Centauri A and B and learns that Goku has found an active Brazilian autofactory building four probes around Alpha Centauri A.
The two Bobs carry out a coordinated surprise attack, with Calvin drawing attention and Goku striking from behind.
Their assault destroys most of the construction yard, three Brazilian probes, and all four incoming missiles, but one Brazilian vessel escapes.
After inspecting the wreckage, Calvin and Goku decide Alpha Centauri should be reinforced with combat-class Bobs and that Alpha Centauri A's comfort-zone planet needs closer inspection.
summary.pov_emotional_arc: Calvin moves from patient, frustrated reconnaissance into reluctant acceptance of violence, then ends the chapter grimly satisfied but uneasy about the escaped Brazilian threat.

open_threads.text: Bob now knows replicants can go insane during unstructured subjective time, raising the question of whether he can stay sane through training and standby.
Bob is denied access to genealogy records and remains cut off from any living descendants or family connections.
Bob learns that hostile factions inside FAITH could sabotage or terminate the replicant project.
Bob now knows several rival nations are racing to launch interstellar probes, with the Brazilian Empire suspected of sabotage and armed competition.
Bob learns the FAITH facility has a hidden tactical nuclear failsafe that could kill him and everyone nearby if someone decides he is too dangerous.
Minister Jacoby leaves after threatening Dr. Landers, raising the question of whether he will act against the replicant project.
The launch turns into a confused orbital battle with missiles, military ships, and multiple unknown attackers, leaving the identity of the factions involved unresolved.
Bob detects apparent nuclear detonations on Earth after hearing of escalating conflict, leaving the scale of the war and Sol's survival uncertain.
After disabling his endocrine control system, Bob begins fully mourning his lost human life, raising the question of how this emotional release will affect him going forward.
Bob concludes that at least one more Brazilian Empire ship exists and that USE, Chinese, and possibly Australian probes may also be active somewhere in space.
Bob's first cohort of clones diverges in personality immediately, raising questions about how future Bob society and identity will evolve.
Milo has found two apparently habitable living worlds at Omicron Eridani, but it remains unresolved whether Earth life and humans are biologically compatible with them.
Milo departs for 82 Eridani, opening the question of what he will find there.
Bill and Garfield now have a working subspace communications system, raising the question of how quickly they can deploy it across multiple star systems.
Riker and Colonel Butterworth agree to try building colony ships in Sol, raising the question of whether the surviving humans can endure long enough to launch them and where they will go.
Bob has discovered intelligent fire-using natives on Delta Eridani 4, raising the question of whether and how he will make first contact.
One Brazilian vessel escapes the destruction of the Alpha Centauri construction yard, leaving its destination and future threat unresolved.
Calvin and Goku conclude Alpha Centauri should be reinforced with combat-class Bobs, raising the question of whether Bill will approve and send them.

recent_events.text: Riker and Homer wipe out the Brazilian force in Sol and save Earth from four extinction-level asteroid strikes.
Bill and Garfield achieve a breakthrough by successfully testing real-time subspace communication.
Riker's mysterious hail turns out to be surviving USE forces, who ask for Bob help to build colony ships and evacuate humanity from dying Earth.
Bob reaches Delta Eridani, starts building up the system, and discovers intelligent alien life on its promising habitable world.
Calvin finds the lost USE probe's wreckage in Alpha Centauri B, then joins Goku in destroying a Brazilian construction yard in Alpha Centauri A.
